proof_body:
by
  intro a p q h1 h2 h
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, (∃ z : ℤ, a (m + 1) = z) ∧ (∃ z : ℤ, a (m + 2) = z) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      refine ⟨ih.2, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ih.1
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ih.2
      refine ⟨p * y + q * x, ?_⟩
      rw [h (m + 1) (by omega), show a (m + 1 + 1) = (y : ℝ) from hy, hx]
      push_cast
      ring
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  exact (key m).1
